mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Fiendish Panda: "Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. When this
# creature dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal
# to this creature's power from your graveyard to the battlefield."
# compiled[0] is the lifegain counter trigger (B9-gain-life-counter-self), kept. The dies trigger
# is M20 Cavalier of Night's verified "When this creature dies, return target creature card with
# mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield." with the target narrowed:
#   another: FNot(IS_SOURCE) (the Panda itself is in the graveyard by then);
#   non-Bear creature card: TYPE_EQ 'Creature' and FNot(SUBTYPE_EQ 'Bear');
#   mana value less than or equal to this creature's power: CMC_LE with the quantity
#   QProp('source', POWER), the source's power as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h,
#   quantity.last_known for the ability's own source, counters included).
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Bear')),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CMC_LE, count=QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.POWER)),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
    }),
)
abilities = [compiled[0], dies, compiled[1]]

clauses.clause: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
When this creature dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
clauses.ir: abilities[1] (CreatureDiesEvent IS_SOURCE; MOVE_ZONE TARGET another non-Bear creature card from your graveyard with CMC_LE this creature's last-known power, to the battlefield)

mapping.notes: Cavalier of Night's verified dies trigger with the target narrowed: another (FNot(IS_SOURCE)), non-Bear creature card (FNot(SUBTYPE_EQ Bear)), CMC_LE QProp('source', POWER): the Panda's power as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h, quantity.last_known for the ability's source), +1/+1 counters included. The lifegain counter trigger is the compiler's, kept.
